speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You are in, and the afternoon is still young. I thought you had a play.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The Knave is at two. I am not in it. I am not going back.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Then the loaf is here. It is still a finger short. I have not pulled it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I can see it. I will eat. I have a leaf upstairs that is still not to go out.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I am not a carrier. Eat, and stay off my stair with river mud. Threepence is the board, same as Sunday.
